title: PR Receipt — what did this pull request cost in AI tokens?
oneLiner: For developers and leads running Claude Code/Codex on metered billing, it attributes local agent token spend to each git branch and posts a cost receipt on the pull request.
overlaps: pr-split (idea-board PR tooling) and Github-HQ (portfolio health dashboard) — neither does AI cost attribution; externally closest are ccusage and claude-burn-rate
